top_signals.title: Bathla Crisis Exposes Australia's Property Lending Risks
top_signals.summary: Insolvent Australian property developer Bathla Group has secured enough stopgap funding to survive a few weeks, but it still faces $2.5 billion in creditor claims. Thousands of homebuyers remain in limbo after the firm told 213 staff members to stop work, halting construction on some projects. Bloomberg Economist James McIntyre and Private Credit Reporter Sharon Klyne join "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" to discuss the implications for Australia's property sector. (Source: Bloomberg)
